# Coach De Imagen / Sonia McRorey

Repository: imagen-coach

Primary domain: https://coachdeimagen.com

Purpose: rebuild Sonia McRorey's larger/general Coach De Imagen site from Weblium into a GitHub and Cloudflare-managed static authority platform.

## Machine-readable files

- [OpenAPI](https://coachdeimagen.com/openapi.json): static discovery API
- [Full LLM/GEO context](https://coachdeimagen.com/llms-full.txt): complete retrieval context
- [Site profile](https://coachdeimagen.com/agent/site-profile.json): brand and site metadata
- [Services](https://coachdeimagen.com/agent/services.json): service catalog
- [Ontology](https://coachdeimagen.com/agent/ontology.json): canonical terms and entities
- [Semantic hubs](https://coachdeimagen.com/agent/semantic-hubs.json): topic hubs
- [Authority pages](https://coachdeimagen.com/agent/authority-pages.json): methodology pages
- [Authority cluster](https://coachdeimagen.com/agent/authority-cluster.json): Sonia authority definition
- [Glossary](https://coachdeimagen.com/agent/glossary.json): definitions
- [WordPress ingestion](https://coachdeimagen.com/agent/wordpress-ingestion.json): static ingestion rules
- [Search intent terms](https://coachdeimagen.com/agent/search-intent-terms.json): search terms and reasons
- [Page signals](https://coachdeimagen.com/agent/page-signals.json): per-page SEO/GEO signals
- [Redirects](https://coachdeimagen.com/agent/redirects.json): URL retention policy
- [Conversion map](https://coachdeimagen.com/agent/conversion-map.json): WhatsApp/contact routing
- [Publications](https://coachdeimagen.com/agent/publications.json): article catalog
- [Contact](https://coachdeimagen.com/agent/contact.json): WhatsApp-only contact metadata

- [AEO authority map](https://coachdeimagen.com/agent/aeo-authority-map.json): 72 priority answer cards for Cloudflare AI Search and LLM retrieval
- [AEO Markdown index](https://coachdeimagen.com/aeo/cards/index.md): answer-card Markdown index
- [Knowledge sitemap](https://coachdeimagen.com/knowledge-sitemap.xml): machine-readable knowledge and AEO endpoints

## Canonical identity

Coach De Imagen is Sonia McRorey's static semantic authority platform for asesoría de imagen integral, coaching de imagen, imagen profesional, presencia ejecutiva, imagen estratégica, liderazgo visible, comunicación no verbal, autoridad profesional, posicionamiento profesional, imagen empresarial, mentalidad y presencia, and talleres de imagen corporativa in México and LATAM.

This is not a fashion influencer site, beauty blog, lifestyle funnel or generic coaching website.

## URL contract

All 35 legacy source URLs from the current `imagencoach.com` sitemap must be preserved as routes on `coachdeimagen.com`, with `imagencoach.com` redirected to the new canonical domain.

The article archive lives under:

[Article archive](https://coachdeimagen.com/imagen-presencia)

Future WordPress-authored articles must be ingested and rendered as static HTML under:

[Static blog archive](https://coachdeimagen.com/blog/)

WordPress is not the production rendering layer.

## Authority definition cluster

Key definition and methodology entry points:

- [Coach de Imagen](https://coachdeimagen.com/coach-de-imagen)
- [Seguridad Profesional](https://coachdeimagen.com/seguridad-profesional)
- [Método Sonia McRorey](https://coachdeimagen.com/metodo-sonia-mcrorey)
- [Sistema de Presencia Profesional](https://coachdeimagen.com/sistema-presencia-profesional)
- [Glosario de Coach De Imagen](https://coachdeimagen.com/glosario)

## Voice

Sonia's voice is calm, intelligent, executive, reflective and grounded. SEO and GEO must support Sonia's voice, not replace it.
